topics.label: Introduction to the hallmarks of cancer
topics.groupedBecause: It introduces the lecture themes, learning outcomes, and multi-step model for understanding the hallmarks of cancer.

topics.label: Growth signaling pathways and oncogenic mutations
topics.groupedBecause: They explain how mutations in receptor tyrosine kinase and Wnt/beta-catenin pathways enable cancer cells to achieve growth signal independence and evade growth inhibitory signals.

topics.label: Blocks to terminal differentiation in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: They explore how differentiation is arrested in hematopoietic malignancies and intestinal epithelium to sustain an immature, proliferative cellular state.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis through p53 and Bcl-2 regulation
topics.groupedBecause: It details how alterations in p53, Bax, and Bcl-2 shift the apoptotic threshold to allow cancer cells to resist programmed cell death.

topics.label: Replicative immortality, senescence, and p53 genome surveillance
topics.groupedBecause: They examine how telomere shortening and cellular stress signals trigger p53-dependent senescence, and how cancer cells bypass these barriers to achieve unlimited replication.

topics.label: Cancer metabolic rewiring and oncometabolites
topics.groupedBecause: They transition to complex cancer hallmarks and explain the mechanisms, functional advantages, and epigenetic consequences of metabolic reprogramming such as the Warburg effect.

topics.label: Tumor angiogenesis and the angiogenic switch
topics.groupedBecause: It explains how growing tumors overcome nutrient and oxygen diffusion limits by activating the angiogenic switch to recruit vasculature.

topics.label: Mechanisms, dissemination, and genomics of tumor metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: They describe the cellular barriers of the metastatic cascade, seed-and-soil dynamics, clinical monitoring via circulating tumor cells, and associated genomic features.

topics.label: Summary and concluding remarks
topics.groupedBecause: It concludes the lecture with a summary of cancer hallmark integration and reminders for upcoming practical sessions.
